build_sing_parser: build an argparse parser for training a SING model on the NSynth dataset with configurable autoencoder and sequence generator options
configure_autoencoder_args: configure autoencoder arguments including channels, stride, dimension, kernel size, rewrite layers, and context size for SING model training
setup_sequence_generator_parser: setup sequence generator parser with LSTM hidden size, layers, truncated gradient, and epoch settings for SING model training
configure_loss_and_training_args: configure loss and training arguments including wav loss, l1 loss, epsilon offset, learning rate, and batch size for SING model
configure_lookup_table_embeddings: configure lookup table embedding dimensions for time step, instrument, pitch, and velocity in SING model training
